items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: Jim Crow, Slow Drag, George Lewis, me, and Lawrence Morell.

ctx.x: You weren't in the local before that?

No, we was on union. So this fellow, Kennedy, he told me, he said, yeah, he said, y'all got a damn nice set up here. And he said, it's pitiful to be a left-wing monkey ranch. He said, tonight we just got to have y'all on that show. And them guys worked all that day hard. You know, the day before that, going back and forth with Houston. And then they got to set up and give us a couple. Jim Crow, Slow Drag, George Lewis, me, and Lawrence Morell. It didn't cost us a nickel. They put us in there and we were in there…
At Scoop County, they got on.
